responsibility: Implements loop header copying on GIMPLE, duplicating small conditional loop headers so the loop body becomes unconditionally executed after entry. It analyzes candidate header blocks, uses range/path information and structural heuristics to decide profitability, duplicates a prefix of header blocks into the preheader, updates loop form and SSA, and then runs region value-numbering cleanup on the copied path to expose better downstream loop optimizations and vectorization opportunities.
